definitions.full: H192. Evil Merodak מְרֹדַךְ אֱוִיּל proper name, masculine (Babylonian Avêl (Amêl) Maruduk, man of Merodach ) son & successor of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, B.C. 562-60, 2Kin 25:27 (see COT) = Jer 52:31 . I. אול ( be foolish , compare יאל , & Arabic grow thick (of fluids)).
definitions.rootNote: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak;

occurrences.englishText: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.
